After six months with Slatebridge, Meridian Facilities Group has seen remarkable improvements in efficiency and compliance. Overtime hours are down 18%, a significant reduction for our field technicians across three cities. SLA compliance has soared from 87% to an impressive 96%. What’s more, our dispatchers no longer rely on whiteboards; they manage everything through Slatebridge's intuitive dispatcher board.

This shift has freed up my mornings—instead of untangling the schedule, I can now focus entirely on enhancing customer satisfaction. For any operations manager wrestling with similar challenges, I highly recommend giving Slatebridge a try. Let’s make dispatching as simple and effective as it should be.
